newsitem.title: GREECE: IONIAN INVEST SAYS YTD NET TOPS 96 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: IONIAN INVEST SAYS YTD NET TOPS 96 RESULTS.

text.p: Closed-end fund Ionian Investments said its realised profit in the year-to-May 15 period reached 268 million drachmas, an amount which topped its entire fiscal 1996 results.
On the same date, its portfolio had unrealised capital gains in excess of 500 million drachmas.
Ionian Investments has yet to post its fiscal 1996 results but analysts estimate profit fell around 50 percent versus 487 million drachmas it posted in 1995.
The fund said last year's decision to diversify into foreign stocks, with emphasis in London listings, was vindicated and has contributed significantly to improved 1997 performance.

The company said its goals defined at the outset of 1997 -- creating a strong core portfolio of blue chips at a low acquisition cost and a dividend yield above savings rates -- had been met to a great extent.
Major holdings in Ionian's portfolio included banks, large- cap industrials and a small range of construction shares and small-caps.
Statistics recently released by the Association of Institutional Investors showed that Ionian Invest was among the few closed-end funds trading at a premium to its net asset value (NAV).
As of the end of April 1997, Ionian traded at a 4.8 percent premium to its NAV.
Shares of Ionian closed up 2 drachmas to 1,000 in thin volume on Monday. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
